craft_evidence.owned: part-owned — 'our story': since 2020 'a longtime vendor, and the owners of one of our most forward-thinking, progressive factories' is an equity partner; the factory is not named
craft_evidence.makers: none — product pages give country of origin only
craft_evidence.mills: none — fibre programmes only (Lenzing ECOVERO, 'Regenerative Cotton', 'Certified Cashmere')
craft_evidence.madein: 79 of 79 sampled product pages state a 'Country of Origin': China 35, India 31, Portugal 4, Turkey 4, Vietnam 3, USA 2
craft_evidence.heritage: vague — founders and an ownership collective described; no founding date or place found in the story text read
craft_evidence.process: partial — a 2030 Roadmap and yearly impact updates (2022–2025) cover traceability and factory social/environmental work; nothing step-by-step on making
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every product page states the country of origin, and the brand says one of its factories became an equity partner in 2020 and publishes yearly impact updates — more than most. But no factory, workshop or mill is named on the pages read, so the making is still not checkable beyond the country.
